title: Normalized realization interfaces for integral quotient systems
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and an embedding $\iota:E\to L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On each small pro-etale site use the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] and the quotient system calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. For whole-system inverse image and scalar change [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems], define the constant-tower/derived-limit adjunction and its counit in the derived category of whole towers [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], normalized on K-injective tower resolutions by the ordinary limit cone. Define a Roos realization model by its natural comparison with total derived limit and its limit-tuple/zero-shifted-coordinate normalization. Define pullback and scalar realization models for the recorded completed operations [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] by natural realization isomorphisms normalized on every flat-term K-flat representative and every simultaneous quotient presentation. The normalization uses the actual quotient transitions, pullback unit and tensor generators, and the universal change-of-rings counit [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings].

source.place: Tag 099N, lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case (2),(5), completed pullback and quotient realization; with Tag 0D6D, sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-pullback-composition. The simultaneous integral scalar/composition coherence is an extracted construction, not a verbatim assertion of either tag; blueprint prop-trf-karoubi-independence.proof.md, last sentence.

proof.text: Construct the constant-tower adjunction using the exact-functor/total-right-derived adjunction. On a K-injective tower, Adjunction.derivedε_fac_app gives its counit after precomposition by the derived unit. Cancel that unit and transport along quotientCompQhIso and mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh to obtain the ordinary limit-cone formula.

Identify module sheaves over the horizontal-constant completed coefficient sheaf on the sequence site with strict towers of completed-coefficient modules. Construct the equivalence by restricting to vertical slices and assembling their horizontal maps; its unit and counit are identity maps on sections. The completed coefficient projections form a natural transformation by the ordinary limit cone equations, giving the ring map to the quotient sequence sheaf. Restriction along this map followed by the equivalence is coefficientSequenceRestriction: its component objects and section maps satisfy the existing unique characterization. The public sheafRingDerivedCoefficientAdjunction theorem applied to the existing derived-change-of-rings witness makes exact derived restriction a right adjoint. Compose this right adjoint with the derived equivalence and transport it along mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso to the specified whole-system derived restriction.

Apply Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit to the reduction adjunction and the composite constant-tower/system-extension adjunction. Its inverse comparison is leftAdjointUniq in the opposite order. Adjunction.comp_counit_app then gives the displayed reduction-counit formula.

For a tower complex, form the product of its ordinary limit projections. The limit cone equations show its composite with 1 minus shift is zero. Mathlib mappingCocone.lift with zero degree-minus-one cochain constructs the required map. Product extensionality fixes its first coordinate; the zero second coordinate and mappingCocone.id_X fix each degree of the whole map, proving uniqueness.

The object component of coefficientSequenceRestriction_exists identifies the restricted evaluation with scalarReductionRestriction of evaluation. Scalar restriction preserves the underlying abelian sheaf, so coefficientSequenceEvaluationAb_eq gives the equality of section types. All normalized realization structures and their signatures remain unchanged.

proof_origin: Stage 3 proofs by R6 and J3, 2026-10-19: R6 supplies the derived-counit normalization, adjoint uniqueness and explicit mapping-cocone lift. J3 closes the remaining whole-system right-adjoint obligation by an explicit equivalence for module sheaves on the vertical product site, quotient-ring restriction, and the public sheaf-ring derived coefficient adjunction applied to the existing derived-change-of-rings witness. All original statements and definitions are unchanged.
